description: SAN MATEO, CA – Today, San Mateo Deputy Mayor Diane Papan issued the following statement in response to the impressive June 7th Primary Election results update by the San Mateo County Clerk’s Office:“Since Election Night, one thing has remained clear, the voters of this District have spoken and spoken loudly. title: San Mateo Deputy Mayor Diane Papan Decisively Wins June Primary By A 2:1 Margin
